memories.content: Bill believes the fence is a shared responsibility and expects the Osei family to pay half. He is willing to negotiate but prefers to avoid court. He has limited savings and is concerned about costs.

A storm has damaged the shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property. The fence is old and its exact ownership is unclear from property records. Both parties have homeowner's insurance that may cover some damage, but deductibles apply. They have exchanged initial messages but no agreement yet. Small claims court is an option if they cannot agree.
